data.Name: TP-01 | Gather Victim Identity Information: Credentials
data.Source: X3M.AI Threat Profile - System Integrator - TP-01 Identity / Entra ID Compromise
data.Description: Gather credentials associated with personnel of the target organisation from public, criminal, leaked or previously compromised sources. Why it matters: Identity compromise often starts before direct interaction with the tenant. Credentials associated with technical staff, administrators, consultants and support personnel are especially valuable in a system-integrator/MSP context. Primary assets at risk: Privileged identities, Cloud administrators, Technical consultants, Support personnel. Attack-path stage: Targeting / Reconnaissance. Detection opportunities: Credential exposure monitoring; Authentication telemetry correlated with known leaked identities; Identity Protection risk detections. Defensive considerations: Monitor for credential exposure affecting corporate identities; Prioritise privileged and customer-facing personnel for remediation; Enforce phishing-resistant MFA for high-value identities.

Defensive considerations: Minimise unnecessary publication of privileged-user contact details; Use separate privileged identities where appropriate.

Defensive considerations: Avoid public disclosure of unnecessary administrative responsibility; Use role separation and dedicated privileged accounts.
